routes.title: Menu
routes.notes: Unchanged. The menu by category with a running basket; the paused message replaces the basket when ordering is off.

routes.title: Order confirmation
routes.notes: Unchanged. The only wildcard route, so routes/spa.js keeps /order/* and /order answers too (rule 26). The 'Estimated ready' wording is deliberately left as it is this pass.

routes.title: Order queue
routes.notes: CHANGED: 'Mark preparing', 'Mark ready' and 'Cancel order' save again once OrderAdminApi stops naming a Harper-owned timestamp in its write. The page's own calls do not change — it already posts to /OrderAdminApi/status. Two things on this screen are deliberately NOT touched this pass: seeded demo orders showing £0.00 per line, and new orders needing a reload to appear.

routes.title: Menu editor
routes.notes: CHANGED: adding and editing an item both save again. The page's own calls do not change. One frontend detail follows from the fix: createdAt and updatedAt now come back as epoch-millisecond numbers rather than ISO strings, because Harper assigns them, so anything on this screen that renders them must accept a number as well as a string (src/lib/format.ts) — and existing rows written before the fix may still hold a string, so both shapes must render.
